name: Daedalus's Hoard
purpose: Generate local 3D models from images across four GPUs, optionally refine a separate version, compare geometry and export explicitly scaled GLB, STL or PLY files.
notes: Generation and refinement return asynchronous job IDs. Read actual completion with job_get. Refinement chooses DetailGen3D or UltraShape, token count, steps and copy alignment; outputs return to the original frame. Legacy requests retain Detail defaults. Refinement preserves the original and may reduce quality; it is optional. GLB uses meters and STL/PLY millimeters with explicit export scale. Optional print repair measures closure; thickness/supports still need slicer review. No automatic animation retopology or rigging. Text reasoning uses the shared Sparks through Faustus. model_upscale reuses a saved native 512 shape latent for the learned 1024 stage and new materials. job_get includes full_comparison_url and full_clay URLs for complete geometry inspection; preview remains default. model_repair (volume reconstruction or classic surface repair) and model_optimize create optional CPU versions without GPU leases, retaining source originals; inspect closure_verified and actual game budget/texture/file-size reports.
